steps.en: A vehicle search with no outstanding fine returns a no-outstanding message
steps.id: Pencarian kendaraan tanpa fine outstanding mengembalikan pesan tidak ada outstanding

steps.en: A Singpass user with no outstanding fine sees a no-outstanding message
steps.id: User Singpass tanpa fine outstanding melihat pesan tidak ada outstanding
steps.why_en: Only users with no notices at all see the message; users whose notices are all paid see the paid list.
steps.why_id: Pesan hanya muncul untuk user tanpa notice sama sekali; yang semuanya sudah dibayar melihat daftar sudah bayar.

steps.en: The page shows a message that no fee or fine is outstanding
steps.id: Halaman menampilkan pesan bahwa tidak ada fee atau fine outstanding

steps.en: The page lets the offender search again by notice number
steps.id: Halaman memungkinkan offender mencari ulang dengan nomor notice

steps.en: A notice number search shows the notice status more accurately
steps.id: Pencarian nomor notice menampilkan status notice dengan lebih akurat
steps.why_en: A paid notice is dropped from the notice search, so the user gets a not-found message instead of its paid status.
steps.why_id: Notice yang sudah dibayar tidak muncul di pencarian notice, jadi user mendapat pesan tidak ditemukan, bukan status sudah bayar.
